Rainy Night Walk 🌙☔️✨ Color with me in The Cozy Collection by Coco Wyo! For this page I’m only using markers from the Coco Wyo × Ohuhu collab set, plus a white gel pen for the finishing highlights. I wanted the streetlamp to be the focal point, so I kept the nighttime areas cool with blues and purples and switched to brighter, warmer colors wherever the light hits. I also added a soft rainbow reflection across the wet fence and used white highlights at the end to make everything feel shiny after the rain. 🌈✨ One thing I’m trying to share more in these videos is why I choose certain colors and where I place them, instead of only showing the finished page. 🍂🤎 cozy season has officially entered the chat, & i am OBSESSED! ☕✨ there’s just something about fall coloring pages that makes me want to grab my markers, light a candle, put on my favorite comfort show, & completely forget about the outside world. 🍁🧸 today we’re bringing all the warm, cozy autumn vibes to life with a page from the coco wyo x ohuhu cozy collection! 🎨🤎 from the beautiful fall-inspired colors to all the adorable little details, this page was seriously giving me everything i love about this time of year. 🥹🍂 one of my favorite things about coloring is watching a plain black & white page slowly turn into something full of personality, warmth, & color. it’s those tiny details that make the biggest difference, & i swear i fall a little more in love with this hobby every single day. 🫶🏻 book: the cozy collection by @cocowyocoloring  markers: @Ohuhuart  sooo, grab your markers, get comfy, & stay a while. we’re making this little corner of tiktok the coziest place to be this fall. 🤎✨ #cocowyo #ohuhu #cozycoloring #colortok #colorwithme

Here’s the coloring video of my latest page, along with the complete color palette I used! 🎨✨ Let me know what you think!
